TAXA_OCUPACAO.label: Occupancy rate
TAXA_OCUPACAO.meaning: Percentage of available room capacity occupied.

N_REVIEWS.label: Number of reviews
N_REVIEWS.meaning: Number of reviews associated with the hotel-week.

SENTIMENT_SCORE_AVG.label: Average sentiment
SENTIMENT_SCORE_AVG.meaning: Average sentiment score extracted from review text.

EXPECTATION_EXPERIENCE_GAP_AVG.label: Expectation–experience gap
EXPECTATION_EXPERIENCE_GAP_AVG.meaning: Average discrepancy between expressed expectations and reported experience.

SEMANTIC_MISALIGNMENT_SCORE_AVG.label: Semantic misalignment
SEMANTIC_MISALIGNMENT_SCORE_AVG.meaning: Average semantic divergence between expectations and reported experience.

EXPECTATION_VIOLATION_RATIO.label: Expectation violation ratio
EXPECTATION_VIOLATION_RATIO.meaning: Share or ratio of expectation-related observations classified as violated.

MAJOR_MISALIGNMENT_SHARE.label: Major misalignment share
MAJOR_MISALIGNMENT_SHARE.meaning: Share of reviews or review structures showing major expectation–experience misalignment.

EMOTION_ENTROPY.label: Emotional complexity
EMOTION_ENTROPY.meaning: Entropy-based heterogeneity of emotions expressed across reviews.

EXPECTATION_SHARE.label: Expectation share
EXPECTATION_SHARE.meaning: Share of reviews containing identifiable expectations.

HIGH_EXPECTATION_SHARE.label: High-expectation share
HIGH_EXPECTATION_SHARE.meaning: Share of reviews containing high-intensity expectations.

HIGH_MISALIGNMENT_SHARE.label: High-misalignment share
HIGH_MISALIGNMENT_SHARE.meaning: Share of observations with high semantic misalignment.

PERC_REVIEWS_NEGATIVE.label: Reviews containing negative/disliked content
PERC_REVIEWS_NEGATIVE.meaning: Percentage of reviews containing a negative or disliked text component. It does not mean that the full review or numerical rating is negative.
PERC_REVIEWS_NEGATIVE.critical_interpretation_warning: Do not interpret this variable as the percentage of guests giving a negative overall evaluation.

PERC_OPERATIONAL_COMPLAINTS.label: Operational complaint share
PERC_OPERATIONAL_COMPLAINTS.meaning: Percentage of complaint content associated with operational or service-delivery issues.

PERC_PRICE_VALUE_MENTIONS.label: Price–value mention share
PERC_PRICE_VALUE_MENTIONS.meaning: Percentage of review content mentioning price or perceived value.

POLARIZATION_INDEX.label: Review polarization
POLARIZATION_INDEX.meaning: Degree to which review experiences are divided or polarized.

COMPLEXITY_INDEX.label: Experience complexity index
COMPLEXITY_INDEX.meaning: Composite indicator of heterogeneous and layered customer experience signals.

SENTIMENT_TREND_SLOPE.label: Precomputed sentiment trend slope
SENTIMENT_TREND_SLOPE.meaning: Trend slope calculated previously in the source panel. Do not confuse it with the case-window trend recalculated by the Case Builder.

topic_summary.interpretation_note: Topic-source metrics must be interpreted separately. experience_weeks may include positive or neutral experiences. violated_expectation_weeks and emerging_negative_weeks indicate negative evidence. negative_review_mentions are based only on review_text_disliked. Cross-structure topic occurrences may refer to the same underlying issue and are not independent complaints.

review_sample_metadata.selection_strategy: Neutral recent-review sampling. Reviews are ordered by review_date descending and the most recent reviews are selected. No filtering or ranking based on rating, sentiment, complaint severity or text length is used.
review_sample_metadata.interpretation_warning: The sample represents the most recent reviews in the decision window, not necessarily the full review distribution.

complaint_metadata.selection_strategy: Complaint-focused diagnostic sampling. Only reviews with substantive content in review_text_disliked are eligible. Complaints are ranked by lower rating, longer disliked text and recency.
complaint_metadata.interpretation_warning: Selected complaints are diagnostic evidence and are not representative of the complete review distribution. Prevalence should be assessed using the full review-window metadata and managerial evidence.
